quirks: Response is NOT OpenAI-shaped: the reply text is at body.content (a plain string), not body.choices[0].message.content.
Pays via x402 on Base ($0.005 USDC flat per call regardless of token count); also accepts eip155:4326 USDm and Solana USDC per payment.accepts.
Backend masterclaw.dev (#1, GET) is a money-trap: charged $0.05 for an unusable 200 — avoid it; use x402-gateway ($0.005) or blockrun.
usage.guide: Send a POST to the URL with a JSON body containing a `messages` array of {role, content} objects (OpenAI-style chat input). Payment is x402: $0.005 USDC on Base per call, no API key needed. Read the assistant's reply from body.content (a plain string) — note this is NOT the OpenAI choices[] shape. Token usage and cost are reported under body.usage. It is a plain synchronous call; the result returns immediately in the same response.
